title: Workline design revocation record v1
description: An explicit, audited block on one exact baseline revision. The ONLY thing that forbids executing against a published revision.

target.description: The exact baseline this record decides on.

target_digest.description: The digest that baseline had. A record decides on BYTES, not on a name.

author.description: Who decided, or the role that did.

reason.description: Why this revision must not be executed. Not optional: a block without a reason is not auditable.

digest.description: SHA-256 of this record's canonical JSON WITHOUT this field.
